newsitem.title: UK: BBC back on FM in Albania after plea to PM.
newsitem.headline: BBC back on FM in Albania after plea to PM.

text.p: BBC World Service can be heard on FM radio in Albania again after an appeal to Prime Minister Bashkim Fino to turn the BBC transmitter back on.

The 24-hour transmissions to Albania in Albanian and English stopped on March 2 when the BBC's FM transmitter on Mount Dajti in central Albania was switched off following the declaration of a state of emergency, the World Service said on Wednesday.

The transmitter has been switched on again following a World Service telephone call to Fino, it said. Albania has been swept by riots in the past three weeks following the collapse of fraudulent pyramid investment schemes.
Three daily transmissions -- at 0630, 1415 and 1800 GMT -- are broadcast on FM, shortwave and satellite to Albania from Britain and Cyprus.
